word: I open my umbrella as the rain starts.
answer: Abro mi paraguas cuando empieza la lluvia.

word: She admits she forgot her jacket.
answer: Ella admite que olvidó su chamarra.

word: We attend a small workshop inside the library.
answer: Asistimos a un tallercito dentro de la biblioteca.

word: They share their pencils with us.
answer: Ellos comparten sus lápices con nosotros.

word: You cover your backpack with a plastic bag.
answer: Cubres tu mochila con una bolsa de plástico.

word: I decide to stay until the rain stops.
answer: Decido quedarme hasta que pare la lluvia.

word: We describe the sound of the storm.
answer: Describimos el sonido de la tormenta.

word: They discover a cozy reading corner.
answer: Ellos descubren un rincón acogedor para leer.

word: Later we are going to discuss which books to borrow.
answer: Más tarde vamos a discutir qué libros pedir prestados.
